summary: Iteration 38 - Verified backend split of superadmin.py into 4 files (superadmin.py stays + superadmin_gifts.py + superadmin_companies.py + superadmin_campaigns.py) and frontend SizesTooltip + client-side image-dimension validation in Super Admin -> Ads tab. Backend: 16/16 pytest cases PASSED (all 15 requested endpoints respond 200/201 on the same URLs; unauthenticated requests on moved endpoints still return 401/403). Frontend: on /app/super-admin?tab=ads, the '?' SizesTooltip trigger appears next to the upload label, opens on hover with a 12-row table (position / min / ideal) and highlights the current position (banner). Client-side validation correctly rejects a 100x100 PNG for banner (min 728x90) showing toast 'الصورة 100×100 صغيرة جداً. المقاس الأدنى المطلوب: 728×90 — اختاري صورة أكبر' and clears the file input. Regression file: /app/backend/tests/test_iter38_superadmin_split.py.

design_issues.screen: Super Admin -> Ads tab -> SizesTooltip table and min-size label and rejection toast
issues: Bidi/RTL number-pair rendering: 728×90 visually appears as '90×728' (same for 468×60 -> '60×468', 320×50 -> '50×320') because '×' is a bidi-neutral char inside dir='rtl'. Logic is correct (minW=728 really is 728), but users will read the wrong order. Wrap each size pair in an inline-block (e.g. {s.minW}×{s.minH}) in SizesTooltip, in the create/edit labels (AdsTab.js lines ~746 and ~1104), in AdHealthChecker messages (line ~198), and in validateImageDimensions toast (line ~58).

action_items: Optional polish: fix RTL bidi issue so size pairs (e.g. 728×90) always render left-to-right by wrapping in <span dir='ltr'>. No functional bug.
Optional: SizesTooltip currently closes on mouseleave of the whole span but has no explicit close button when opened by click on touch devices - consider adding a small ✕ inside the popup.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/superadmin.py (822 lines), superadmin_companies.py (419 lines), superadmin_gifts.py (360 lines), superadmin_campaigns.py (204 lines) - split is clean, all four routers use APIRouter(prefix='/api') so URLs are preserved. server.py imports+include_router order is correct (lines 2342-2345, 2400-2403). No duplicate endpoint definitions found.

AdsTab.js is still 1353 lines - on the large side. Extract SizesTooltip, AdHealthChecker, validateImageDimensions/readImageDimensions + RECOMMENDED_SIZES into a small shared module (e.g. ads-helpers.js) so they can be reused in other upload forms.

validateImageDimensions rejects on dims.w < minW OR dims.h < minH - correct, but note the banner config has minH=90 while many real banner images are wider/shorter; the check is fine but consider also warning (not blocking) when aspect ratio deviates strongly from the ideal.

RECOMMENDED_SIZES.sidebar = {w:300,h:250, minW:160, minH:600} - minH=600 > idealH=250 is inconsistent and will always reject images unless taller than 600px. Looks like a typo (likely meant minH=60 or minW=600).

superadmin_gifts.py send_user_gift extends end_date from future existing end_date - good. However it does not record the gift record in any collection (gift_record dict is built but never inserted). The gift history is therefore lost. Verify if insert into db.user_gifts is intentional-omitted or a bug.
superadmin_companies.py create_company does not validate email/phone formats or enforce uniqueness of company name - low priority.
Client-side only validation (validateImageDimensions) is bypassable; backend /api/ads upload should also enforce min dimensions using PIL to prevent malicious/small uploads via curl.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested paths (tooltip + validation + create-ad section)

seed_data_creation: Created + cleaned: 1 TEST_iter38_u_* user (left in DB, harmless), 1 TEST_iter38_Company_* company (auto-deleted via DELETE /api/super-admin/companies/{id}). Sent 1 extend_trial gift (+7 days) to first user in DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Route-split is stable and URL-preserving. Regression file covers dashboard, compounds, hierarchical-subs, compound full-details, users (GET+POST), subscription-analytics, expiring-soon-count, auto-renewal-config, send-gift extend_trial, bulk-renewal-offer preview, companies list/create/top10, and bulk-campaigns. Login returns 'access_token' (not 'token'). SuperAdmin route is /app/super-admin (not /super-admin) and ads section uses ?tab=ads query. Validation uses a toast (not window.alert) so page.on('dialog') will not fire - check visible toast DOM or file input value reset instead. RTL bidi-reverse of number pairs like '728×90' is a known visual polish item.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A - no bugs. The split is correct, endpoints respond on identical URLs, and new tooltip/validation UI works end to end.
